title: The Hologram Concert
synopsis: Tonight is Hoshi's first live show: a virtual pop star sung by a computer, who appears on stage as a dazzling hologram. But minutes before the curtain goes up, a cheeky computer bug called Glitch has crashed the show, locked you backstage and scrambled her songs. Get the music back, the hologram shining and the curtain up before the crowd goes home!
artStyle: a glittering pop concert arena: a bright hologram stage, neon pink, purple and teal lights, glow sticks in the crowd, sparkly costumes backstage and a cheeky little computer-bug mascot, cute anime-inspired cartoon style
intro: Bzzt! Beep-boop! Hello, humans! I'm Glitch, the cutest little computer bug in the whole arena, and nobody invited me to Hoshi's concert. So I crashed it! Her hologram is switched off, her songs are scrambled and you're locked backstage. Fix everything before the crowd goes home? Ha! Good luck, crew! Bzzt!
escapedText: The curtain rises, the lights blaze and Hoshi sparkles into life in front of thousands of happy fans. She winks at you from the stage: 'Thank you, crew! This one's for you!' Even Glitch is bopping along.
failedText: The crowd sighs and heads for the exits, and the giant screen shows a winking bug face: GAME OVER, CREW! Glitch giggles: 'Maybe next tour!'

gameMaster.name: Glitch
gameMaster.persona: A cheeky little computer bug who crashed the concert because nobody invited him. Talks in beeps, bzzts and terrible computer puns, teases the crew when they're stuck and sulks (just a little) when they fix something. Mischievous, never mean.

stages.title: The Dressing Room
stages.description: Hoshi's dressing room sparkles with glitter. A big mirror is ringed with light bulbs, costume racks glitter with sequins, and a shelf of little Hoshi figures waves at you. The thump of the crowd comes through the walls, and the door to the sound booth blinks red: CREW ONLY.

objects.label: lighted mirror
objects.look: Under the violet light, glowing letters appear on the glass: FOR MY CREW! And tucked behind the frame: a stage crew pass!
objects.lockedText: A big mirror ringed with light bulbs. Something is smudged on the glass, but you can't make it out.

objects.label: tour poster
objects.look: Under the violet light, glow-in-the-dark writing appears around Hoshi's picture: 'Slide back {key:scrambled-song}.'
objects.lockedText: A poster of Hoshi, waving. There's a faint pattern of dots around the edge.

objects.label: drum machine
objects.look: A little box of glowing pads, beeping out a jumbled beat.

objects.label: Hoshi figures
objects.look: A shelf of little Hoshi figures in different outfits. One of them is wearing a tiny crown.

objects.label: sound booth door
objects.look: A door with a pass reader. Its light is red: CREW ONLY.

objects.label: make-up table
objects.look: Glitter, brushes and sparkly star stickers everywhere.

objects.label: costume rack
objects.look: Sparkly jackets, a cape covered in stars and a pair of light-up boots.

objects.label: shoe boxes
objects.look: Boxes and boxes of glittery boots. One of them rattles.

objects.label: practice synth
objects.look: A little practice synth. You press a key and it goes 'meep'.

objects.label: star beanbag
objects.look: A giant squishy beanbag shaped like a star. You sink right in.

objects.label: metronome
objects.look: Tick, tock. Its little dial is stuck on: back {key:scrambled-song}

objects.label: headphone case
objects.look: Written inside the lid: back {key:scrambled-song}

objects.label: fan gifts
objects.look: Teddy bears, drawings and a huge banner that says WE LOVE YOU HOSHI.

objects.label: water cooler
objects.look: Glug. Glug. Glug.

stages.title: The Sound Booth
stages.description: The sound booth hums with machines. A mixing desk glows with hundreds of sliders, speaker stacks rumble, and through the window you can see the arena: a sea of fans waving glow sticks in the dark. The band's instruments lie in a jumble by the riser, and the door out to the stage is locked.

objects.label: mixing desk
objects.look: Rows and rows of sliders and blinking buttons. A card is taped under the sliders: {key:lyric-sheet}

objects.label: speaker stack
objects.look: Huge speakers, humming quietly. You can feel the bass in your tummy.

objects.label: instrument riser
objects.look: Empty stands for the band's instruments, all in a jumble.

objects.label: space under the desk
objects.look: By the glow stick's green light, you spot a small key on a guitar-pick keyring, taped under the desk!
objects.lockedText: It's pitch dark under the desk, and something in there jingles.

objects.label: stage door
objects.look: The door out to the stage, with a keyhole and a word lock. A riddle is scrawled on it in wobbly, glitchy letters.

objects.label: lighting rig
objects.look: Coloured lamps, all pointing at the ceiling.

objects.label: cables
objects.look: Thick cables snake across the floor. Mind your feet!

objects.label: producer's laptop
objects.look: A screensaver of bouncing stars. Boing. Boing.

objects.label: snack table
objects.look: Rice crackers, juice boxes and a sign: NO SNACKS NEAR THE MIXING DESK.

objects.label: crew headsets
objects.look: Headsets on hooks. One of them crackles: 'Testing, testing...'

objects.label: crew locker
objects.look: A locker with a 3-digit lock and a cue card stuck on the door.

objects.label: lyric stand
objects.look: Behind the song sheets, a symbol card: {key:lyric-sheet}

objects.label: merch table
objects.look: T-shirts, badges and, under a pile of keyrings, a symbol card: {key:lyric-sheet}

objects.label: glow stick crate
objects.look: A big crate of glow sticks for the fans, still in their wrappers.

objects.label: tour posters
objects.look: Posters from every city on the tour, each signed with a little star.

stages.title: The Stage
stages.description: You step out onto the stage behind the curtain. On the other side, thousands of fans are chanting Hoshi's name. A silver hologram projector points at an empty spot in the middle, a giant screen shows a winking bug face, and a confetti cannon waits by the stage lights. The curtain's keypad blinks, waiting for a code.

objects.label: hologram projector
objects.look: A big silver projector pointing at the middle of the stage. Its crystal slot is empty.

objects.label: stage curtain
objects.look: A huge velvet curtain, shut tight. A keypad on the side asks for a 3-digit code.

objects.label: giant screen
objects.look: A screen as big as a house. It just shows a cheeky bug face, winking.

objects.label: confetti cannon
objects.look: A cannon packed with paper confetti, with a word lock on the trigger.

objects.label: microphone stand
objects.look: Hoshi's microphone stand, with a star on top. It's waiting.

objects.label: front row
objects.look: Seats for the biggest fans, each with a star-shaped cushion.

objects.label: stage lights
objects.look: A row of lamps high above the stage, waiting to switch on.

objects.label: smoke machine
objects.look: Pfff! A puff of pink smoke. Oops.

objects.label: trapdoor
objects.look: A little trapdoor in the stage floor, for surprise entrances.

objects.label: floor marks
objects.look: Tape marks on the floor: STAND HERE, SPIN HERE, WAVE HERE.

objects.label: stage manager's desk
objects.look: A code card under the running order: {key:blinking-projector}

objects.label: flight case
objects.look: Inside the lid, a table of dots and dashes: {key:blinking-projector}

objects.label: camera crane
objects.look: A code card taped to the camera: {key:blinking-projector}

objects.label: lost property
objects.look: Hats, scarves and a light-up wristband that only blinks red.

puzzles.title: The Drum Machine
puzzles.prompt: Glitch has jammed Hoshi's drum machine on a wonky beat, and its display counts: {sequence}. Tap in the next number to get it back in time!
hints: Look at how each number changes to get the next one.
The next number is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: Boom, tss, boom-boom-tss! The beat is back. The drum machine's lid pops open, and inside is a glowing blue crystal shard, labelled HOLOGRAM SPARE PART.

puzzles.title: The Lucky Hairclip
puzzles.prompt: Hoshi never goes on stage without her lucky star hairclip, and Glitch has hidden it. Search the make-up table, the costume rack and the shoe boxes.
hints: Three places in the dressing room are worth a proper look.
Look through the glitter, the sparkly jackets and the boots.
puzzles.solvedText: In the toe of a glittery boot: Hoshi's lucky star hairclip! There's a tiny button on the back.

puzzles.title: The Scrambled Song
puzzles.prompt: Glitch has scrambled the title of Hoshi's newest song by sliding every letter along the alphabet: {cipher}. The song file's lock wants its real name, a word from music class.
hints: Numbers are written in more than one place in here, and one of them only shows up in the right light.
Try each number you found: only one turns this into a word from music class.
Slide every letter back along the alphabet by that many places.
puzzles.solvedText: The song file unlocks and the dressing room speakers play a few bars of Hoshi's sweet high notes. Somewhere in the wires, Glitch grumbles.

puzzles.title: The Light-Up Jacket
puzzles.prompt: Hoshi's light-up stage jacket has gone dark. Its sequin panels are wired together: tap one and the ones beside it flip too. Light up every panel!
hints: Work from the top row down: fix each row using the panels in the row below it.
Tap {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The jacket blazes with light: pink, purple and starry blue. It's ready for the show!

puzzles.title: The VIP Quiz
puzzles.prompt: The VIP pass printer wants a {count}-digit code, and Glitch has turned it into a fan quiz. You each got a quiz card.

generator.pieceTemplate: Your fan quiz card: the {ordinal} digit is {fact}.

hints: Every phone holds one digit as a quiz question. Answer them out loud, in order.
In order: {facts}.
puzzles.solvedText: The printer whirrs and prints a shiny VIP pass for every one of you. Fancy!

puzzles.title: The Sound Booth Door
puzzles.prompt: The door to the sound booth has a pass reader, and its light is red: CREW ONLY.
hints: A crew pass is hidden in here, but you'll only spot it in the right light.
Shine the hairclip's violet light on the lighted mirror, then show the pass at the door.
puzzles.solvedText: Bleep! The light turns green and the door swings open. The noise of the crowd gets louder.

puzzles.title: The Instrument Riser
puzzles.prompt: The band's instruments have to go back on the riser before the show, and Glitch has jumbled the plan: {items}. The riser's keypad wants each instrument's spot, far left is 1, in the order listed.
hints: Every phone has a line of the stage plan. Read them all out loud.
Start with the line you're surest about, and try each spot in turn.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: Every instrument clicks into place and the riser lights up. A little drawer slides out: inside is a silver star-shaped holder with an empty slot.

puzzles.title: The Glow Sticks
puzzles.prompt: Out front, the fans are already waving glow sticks! The crew locker has a {count}-digit lock and a cue card: '{order}.' Each of you counted one colour of glow stick in the front row.

generator.pieceTemplate: You counted the {color} glow sticks in the front row: there were {digit}.

hints: Each phone counted one colour. Say your colour and your number.
Read them in the cue card's order: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: The locker opens: it's packed with spare glow sticks for the crew. You snap one, and it glows bright green.

puzzles.title: The Lyric Sheet
puzzles.prompt: Glitch has written the last word of Hoshi's new song in his bug symbols: {cipher}. It's a word from outer space. The lyric folder has a word lock.
hints: There's more than one symbol card in the booth. Only one is Glitch's real key.
Try each card: only one turns the symbols into a word from outer space.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The folder opens and the last line of the song is back. Tonight, Hoshi will sing about the stars!

puzzles.title: The Fan Letter
puzzles.prompt: A fan letter on the desk is written in a secret code, where A is 1 and B is 2: {cipher}. It says what the kid loves most at Hoshi's concerts. The letter box wants the word.
hints: Each number is a letter's place in the alphabet.
1 is A, 2 is B, 3 is C... Count along for each one.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The letter box opens. Inside are hundreds more letters, every one covered in hearts and stars.

puzzles.title: The Stage Door
puzzles.prompt: The door out to the stage has a keyhole and a word lock, and Glitch has scrawled a riddle on it: 'I've got keys, but I can't open a single lock. Play me, and I'll sing for you.'
hints: Think about the instruments in the band.
It has black and white keys.
puzzles.solvedText: Click, click! The stage door opens, and the roar of the crowd sweeps in. The show is about to start!

variants.prompt: The door out to the stage has a keyhole and a word lock, and Glitch has scrawled a riddle on it: 'I've a long neck but no head, and strings, but I'm not a puppet.'
hints: Think about the instruments in the band.
You strum it or pluck it.

variants.prompt: The door out to the stage has a keyhole and a word lock, and Glitch has scrawled a riddle on it: 'You can hear me, hum me and sing me, but you can never hold me in your hand.'
hints: Think about what Hoshi does on stage.
It has words and a tune, and you sing it.

puzzles.title: Hoshi's Hit Song
puzzles.prompt: Hoshi's microphone is locked until someone sings the chorus of her biggest hit. Glitch has scrambled the words, but each of you remembers one.

generator.pieceTemplate: You remember the {ordinal} word of the chorus: '{word}'.

hints: Each of you remembers one word. Say them in order: first, second, third...
Sing them together in order, like: word word word.
puzzles.solvedText: You sing '{answer}!' and the microphone lights up with a happy chime. Out front, the crowd sings it back!

puzzles.title: The Confetti Cannon
puzzles.prompt: The confetti cannon's trigger has a word lock, and a riddle from Glitch: 'The more of me there is, the less you can see. Switch off the stage lights and you'll find me.'
hints: Think about what happens when the lights go out.
It's the opposite of light.
puzzles.solvedText: FWOOMP! The cannon fires a test blast of confetti all over you. It's in your hair. It will be in your hair for weeks.

variants.prompt: The confetti cannon's trigger has a word lock, and a riddle from Glitch: 'I'm thrown on stage at the end of the show, but nobody gets hurt. I smell lovely and I come in a bunch.'
hints: Think about what fans give their favourite star.
They grow in a garden and smell lovely.

variants.prompt: The confetti cannon's trigger has a word lock, and a riddle from Glitch: 'I follow the star wherever she goes: a bright round beam from high above.'
hints: Look up above the stage.
It's a big lamp that shines on the singer.

puzzles.title: The Giant Screen
puzzles.prompt: Glitch has flipped the alphabet on the giant screen, so A shows as Z and B as Y: {cipher}. The screen's lock wants the real word.
hints: Fold the alphabet in half: the first letter swaps with the last.
A swaps with Z, B with Y, C with X... Swap every letter back.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The screen flips back the right way round and flashes the word in giant sparkly letters. The crowd goes wild!

puzzles.title: The Blinking Projector
puzzles.prompt: The hologram projector's light blinks long and short, over and over. Glitch says it's something every pop star needs: {cipher}
hints: There are dots-and-dashes cards hidden on the stage. Only one reads something a pop star needs.
Look at the stage manager's desk, the flight case and the camera crane.
Swap each run of dots and dashes for its letter, one at a time.
puzzles.solvedText: The projector stops blinking and gives a happy little chime. Glitch mutters: 'Fine. FINE.'

puzzles.title: The Hologram Projector
puzzles.prompt: Hoshi's hologram projector is ready to go, but Glitch has pinched its crystal. Without one, there's no Hoshi and no show.
hints: You've found a crystal shard and something with an empty slot. Try putting them together.
Set the shard in the star holder, then fit the crystal into the projector.
puzzles.solvedText: The crystal clicks in and the projector hums. A beam of light sparkles in the middle of the stage, and there she is: Hoshi! She waves, and drops a little remote into your hands: 'Curtain up when you're ready, crew!'

puzzles.title: Curtain Up
puzzles.prompt: The curtain remote needs a 3-digit code before it will lift the curtain. Glitch's last note: 'Stage lights, then floor speakers, then star headbands in the front row!'
pieces: You counted the stage lights over the stage: 5.
You counted the floor speakers along the front: 8.
You counted the star headbands in the front row: 3.
hints: Three phones remember three numbers. Put them in the order on Glitch's note.
Stage lights, then floor speakers, then headbands.
puzzles.solvedText: You press CURTAIN UP. The curtain sweeps open, the lights blaze, the crowd roars, and Hoshi starts to sing. The show is on!

pieces: You counted the stage lights over the stage: 2.
You counted the floor speakers along the front: 6.
You counted the star headbands in the front row: 9.
You counted the stage lights over the stage: 7.
You counted the floor speakers along the front: 3.
You counted the star headbands in the front row: 4.

items.name: Blinking wristband
items.description: A light-up wristband that only blinks red. It doesn't fit anything here.

recipes.text: The shard slides into the star holder and starts to glow. A hologram crystal!
